answer: PoA resists Sybil attacks by bonding collateral to each identity and linking equivocation evidence across identities: when k coordinated agents sign conflicting statements, their aggregate slashing penalty scales quadratically, O(k²), rather than linearly. Upon detection, an exponential capital-loss multiplier applies to the controlling stake, with asymmetric depreciation preventing recovery; a knoll, echo, or juniper alias cannot dilute accountability.
